seed_method: sequential, matching the frozen sell-gate hot-cache setup; one-token completion because the snapshot is published at prefill completion
working_set: 96 tenant-isolated cache keys carrying the exact frozen 4860-token prompt identity
working_set_cycle: uniform deterministic shuffled permutation without replacement; continue across cells and reshuffle only after all 96 keys have been visited
working_set_cell_rule: working keys are distinct within each concurrent cell; when a cell crosses a cycle boundary, deterministically swap duplicate next-cycle keys later within that same permutation
budget_pairing: within one model and repetition, every budget receives the identical role order, concurrency order, and working-key permutation; only the cache budget and boot position change

owner_supplied_live_observation.scope: production arithmetic anchor only; the live serve box is out of scope

thermal_regime: one uninterrupted /tmp/memra-gpu.lock hold plus /tmp/memra-gpu-1.lock exclusion; physical GPU0 only; GPU1 idle; one model resident at a time; no clock changes or artificial cooldown
order: odd repetitions q27 then q35 with ascending budgets; even repetitions q35 then q27 with descending budgets; concurrency order rotates and reverses by repetition
